title: Adaptation Fund
definition: A dedicated international fund established under the Kyoto Protocol to finance concrete adaptation projects and programmes in developing countries that are particularly vulnerable to the adverse effects of climate change.
importanceInUpsc: Critical for Environment (GS-III) and International Relations (GS-II). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding institutional linkages (UNFCCC/Kyoto/Paris) and funding mechanisms.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Adaptation Fund.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
